from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class TaxPayment(BaseModel):
    """One company's '支付的各项税费' amount from a single financial report."""
    company_name: str = Field(description="The company name from the financial report")
    tax_paid_amount: float = Field(description="Amount of '支付的各项税费' from the cash flow statement")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., '2024年第一季度'")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Verbatim line containing the tax amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    tax_payments: list[TaxPayment]
